title: No Books
description: This mod removes every book in Minecraft so you can’t craft, find, or use them at all. Enchanting, written books, and anything that needs a book just disappears, making the game way more bare-bones and challenging.
body: No Books wipes all book-related items from the game: regular books, enchanted books, book & quill, written books, even bookshelf recipes that require them. You can’t enchant the normal way, can’t store text, and can’t use any loot-book mechanics. It turns the game into a more raw, grindy survival experience where you rely only on your gear and crafting skills without enchantments or book-based progression.
